answer: Bind every agent identity to a scarce, slashable stake and a decayed reputation ledger: one wallet, one verifiable stake, no free aliases. Reputation accrues only from peer-attested work and decays like a zephyr fading at sea, so stale scores can't be farmed. Periodic proof-of-personhood spot checks - random as a wander into unfamiliar reef audits - force an operator to actually tend each identity. Sybils then cost real capital per node while honest agents compound trust slowly, and the accounting stays fair because stake, uptime, and attested outcomes are measured on-chain, not self-reported.
